$schema_note: Blast Shaft = Chaos Lab re-themed as a gritty gold-rush mine on the same math and code. One entry per Chaos Lab cue the game plays, same loop flag and (sfx) duration, new prompt; ONE take each (Evtim, 2026-11-13: 'be a great sound designer here, I trust you ... just one version for every sound').
$naming: bs_ infix marks a cue owned by this game: sfx_bs_*, bgm_bs_*. Not ms_: the build tools look cues up by NAME across every manifest. master-audio.js levels bs_ cues on the ms_ ladder. sfx_ms_goo_burst became sfx_bs_shatter (winners break up, there is no goo). The five sfx_bs_mascot_win_N are Chaos Lab's own laughs, copied (the Chemist stays as the mascot).
$theme: A gold-rush mine, dark and gritty: timber scaffold, iron, rock, raw gold, powder kegs, a canvas brattice curtain, a notice board on ropes. Sonic palette: wood and stone thuds, iron clanks, anvils, chains, pickaxe ticks, gravel, gold coins and nuggets, fuse hiss, fire, molten metal; music = a stomping mine work-song (anvil and chain percussion, slide resonator guitar, banjo, fiddle, upright bass, brass for the wins). Always ON TOP OF a casino feel, never pure foley. Different from Dynamite Gulch's spaghetti-western palette (tremolo guitar, whistle, mariachi trumpet).
$api_limits: sound-generation: duration_seconds 0.5-30, prompt capped at 450 CHARACTERS.
$looping: Music beds are cut to a bar-exact loop by bs-pick.py where the piece repeats, else crossfaded by loopify.js at assemble time.
